confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates for a mid-to-high-priced Australian coastal resort town in July (winter, school-holiday peak). Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by season and booking window. Prices were not checked against live listings. The FX observation comes from search-result content that cites the RBA exchange rates page; I did not open that page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other Australian coastal tourist towns with similar demand, such as the Gold Coast, Noosa and the Sunshine Coast hinterland, with an uplift for Byron Bay's premium café and bar pricing. Drink anchors use the typical Australian relationship between a schooner of draft beer and a cocktail or glass of wine.
